english_evidence: Official site: 'Tevens verzorgen wij autorijlessen in het Engels - our driving school offers driving lessons in English.' Corroborated by multiple English-language learner reviews (e.g. 'He also speaks English fluently so I could take my lessons, the mock exam and the practical exam all in English without a problem').
waitlist_signal: Reviewer (Jan 2025): 'Getting a spot for driving lessons was a four-week wait, but it was well worth it!'
notes: One-instructor school run by Peter Garnefski (founded January 2006 per rijschool-tips.nl, 'al ruim 18 jaar' per own site). Specialises in coaching people with faalangst/rijangst (exam/driving anxiety), autism, ADD and ADHD. Promises 60-min lessons with no picking up/dropping off other students during your lesson; works with TOP ONLINE exam-planning system at CBR Den Bosch. klantenvertellen total score 9.4 over 168 reviews, 100% recommend; 9 reviews in last 12 months. CBR pass-rate figures vary by source (~62-63%).
